about: Shared data for Modules 11 to 17 (build-sections.cjs) and the Intake 140 study guides (build_guides.py). presets: Shape Canvas shapes opened by #sc= links. modules: per hub module, the preset, its link label, the shop note and the study guide page.

t: ID 245 mm + 2 × 10 mm plate = OD 265 mm, so r = 132.5 mm.
D = 168 mm, L = 200 mm on the centre line, cut 22.5° off square.
Shortest line a = 165 mm. Longest line b = 235 mm.

dfoot.note: Decimal feet = feet + inches ÷ 12. To go back: decimal part × 12 = inches, decimal part of the inches × 16 = sixteenths.
dfoot.watch: 12 inches in a foot, not 10. 6'-4 7/8" is 6.40625', not 6.4875'.

circles.note: C = π × D. Use the π key, not 3.14, unless the sheet says so. Keep every digit until the last step.
circles.watch: Double the radius first. π × r gives only half the circumference.

rolled.scLabel: the rolled ring with its stretch-out
rolled.note: MD = ID + T, or MD = OD − T. SO = π × MD.
rolled.watch: Do not cut to π × OD. It is too long by about π × T.

mass.note: Shop rule: 40.8 lb per square foot for each inch of thickness, or 7.85 kg per square metre for each millimetre.
mass.watch: Metric rule: length and width in metres, thickness in millimetres. Imperial in inches: divide by 144.

capacity.note: Course factor: 1 cubic foot holds 6.25 gallons. 1 cubic foot = 1,728 cubic inches. 1 cubic metre holds 1,000 litres.
capacity.watch: Use the inside sizes. Outside sizes count the plate.

pld.scLabel: the cut pipe with its 12-space pattern
pld.note: Stretch-out = π × D, divided into 12 equal spaces. Each element line = L − r × tan θ × cos(angle around the pipe).
pld.watch: Check the calculator shows DEG before you press tan, sin or cos.

pkg.guideHelp: Try each answer, then see the keys. Trusses, formed plate, tank fit-ups.
pkg.note: Truss: C = √(A² + B²), F = B − E, G = F × A ÷ B, I = √(F² + G²), H = C − I. Formed plate: MR = IR + ½T, B = π × MR × 90 ÷ 180. Tank: B = π × (OD − T), mass at 40.8 lb per sq ft per inch, 6.25 gallons per cubic foot.
pkg.watch: Tank fit-ups differ only in where the end plates sit. Inside flush: A = OAL, and the inside length is OAL − 2 × EP.
